description: Adaptive compensation parameters for SO-101 Robot 2
_z_offset_comment: Per-robot pick/place z offset (meters, signed). Added to BOTH execute_pick_object and execute_place_object commanded z. Positive = raise (descend less), negative = descend further. 2026-05-24: 0.0 → +0.03 (+3cm).
_pick_xy_offset_comment: Per-robot pick xy radial overshoot (meters, signed). Pushes execute_pick_object's pick xy outward along the base→object radial direction. Positive = reach further out. Compensates the controller's systematic radial undershoot at Hold-phase plateau (elbow/wrist_flex deadband). 2026-05-24: 0.01 → 0.0.
_pick_offset_comment: Per-robot pick depth from object top (meters). execute_pick_object uses pick_z = object_height - pick_offset + z_offset. Larger = descend lower. 2026-06-04: set to 0.04 with z_offset=+0.03 so ws1 robot2 forward/reset pick commands 1cm below object top.
_place_offset_comment: Per-robot additional place descent (meters). execute_place_object subtracts this from computed place_z. Larger = release lower. 2026-06-04: set to 0.02 so ws1 robot2 places blocks 2cm lower.

gravity_sag._comment: sag = gain * reach^reach_power * max(0, z - z_deadzone). Calibrated from robot2 logs.
